result:
All defects fixed. Summary:

## The major defect was real — and I fixed it at the root

The validator was right: my control matched on walk *count*, but gensim scales with *tokens*, and meta-path walks truncate. I reproduced its corpus measurement independently (`corpus_size.py`) before touching anything and got its table exactly.

The validator said no re-run was needed — just disclosure. **I disagreed and went further.** A walk-matched control is simply the wrong control here, and disclosure alone would leave the headline as "the null is conservative by an unknown amount." So I ran a genuinely **token-matched control** (DeepWalk ×15 = 4,174,800 tokens vs U-U-U-A-U's 4,068,117, **+2.6%**), 3 seeds, ~3.5 min. That turns a caveat into a measurement.

**The conclusion survived and got stronger.** Against the token-matched control U-U-U-A-U is **+0.0045** test Hit@1 (0.9 sd); against the walk-matched one, −0.0016 (−0.3 sd). The sign flips depending on the control and never reaches one noise sd either way — a more robust null than either control gives alone.

Two things fell out while fixing it:
- **A better cold-start anchor.** Each query ranks 21 candidates with random tie-breaking, so an all-zero row scores exactly chance = **1/21 = 0.0476**. All three social-only configs measure chance. Anchoring to chance is exact and control-independent — and explains why the two controls disagree there (0.0494 vs 0.0803: both noise).
- **A stale number I caught myself.** The ≥16 dilution figure was 0.6644 (old ×22 reference); corrected to 0.6504.

| defect | status |
|---|---|
| [1.1] walks vs tokens | fixed at root — token-matched control added, counts disclosed |
| [1.2] mid-walk truncation | documented with measured lengths (24.3 / 27.5; 32.2% / 43.7% full) |
| [1.3]–[1.5] | all fixed (walk counts, 204.5, `\ref` added, `enumitem` removed) |
| [1.6] length | **was 6 pages, still 6 pages** |

Holding length while *adding* a control row and two disclosures took: switching `[H]`→`[htbp]` (`[H]` was stranding 360pt), prose tightening, caption trims, reclaiming figure legend headroom (fonts unchanged — width stays 6.0in at `0.86\textwidth`), and converting the corpus table to prose (removes presentation, not information — every token count is still machine-checked against `corpus_size.json`). I did **not** cut the type-blind paragraph, per your ruling.

Verified: 21/21 generated table rows match, 183/184 numbers traceable (the one exception is documented arithmetic), lint rc=0, clean 6-page compile with no bad boxes. I re-rendered both figures and looked at them — which caught two collisions I then fixed.

Two honest caveats now in `submission.md`: the token match is +2.6% not exact (integer `num_walks`), and token count is a proxy — shorter walks yield fewer context pairs per token, so U-U-U-A-U may still be marginally under-resourced. Both push in the conservative direction, so neither can manufacture the null.
